summary: C-J1 (FS-GG/.github#4710) binds the Coordination managed-group owner pinned at (FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination, ac22206560f3eddfea524ce8f752ff1d0dfeec4e, eng/managed_group_owner.py, sha256 d846dbe1..., 45315 bytes) into the inline caller of fable-reference-public.yml job wasm-installed-c. The caller fetches the owner through its closed acquisition path, checks size and SHA-256 before import, and then checks the contract schema and the owner's import-time self-hash. It probes containment before any provisioning acquisition. The injected execute(argv,cwd,env) becomes one require-empty run per call, under one never-renewed phase deadline and a fresh out_dir under the job root, with every receipt retained. Each executable must be bound first, with a recorded identity basis: verified download, archive member, installer copy, caller-authored, installer output or host image. The job's Python runs in a sudo systemd-run unit (Delegate=yes, User=runner, NoNewPrivileges, KillMode=control-group, TimeoutStopSec=5, TasksMax/MemoryMax hard limits). Lessons: the supplier refuses control characters in argv, so a multi-line node -e script must be a file; and every real call site's argv should go through the real validate_profile. Cwd must lie inside the profile root. The WASM receiver targets published Workspace.Template 0.19.1 (archive 5d1886c3..., source 1e95ddd), because 0.19.0 Complete scaffolds truncate guest/policy.c and cannot close the byte-exact closure. Still literally held: both steps (if: false) and main() (RUNTIME_ADMITTED=False). A non-required PR probe established hosted containment of tiny host commands only. Not established: per-Playwright groups on the installed-C checker path (that checker runs Playwright in one shell group), the Chromium support/runtime join, the three-family custody pilot, the 27-case journey, and provenance of installer-output and host images.
title: Held installed-WASM caller binds fsgg.managed-group-contract/1; runtime stays literally held
